authoredNote: Shape written first (a TS class hierarchy in a <script lang="ts"> block, the only way an SFC carries classes); the edge NAMES were then read off the run and each was checked against the fixture text line by line — `implements Base -> Shape` is line 16's clause, `overrides Child.area -> Base.area` is line 21's method overriding line 12's, `extends Third -> Child` is line 28.
rationale: The ontology pass RULED `implements` and `overrides` silent on both corpora, and a ruling without a positive probe is a ruling that cannot be falsified: if the JS/TS delegate ever stopped publishing these two edges inside an SFC, every gate would still pass and the ruling would have become a gap. Measured capability on an SFC (production parseFile): extends 2 edges (Child->Base, Third->Child), implements 1 (Base->Shape), overrides 4 (Child.area->Base.area, Base.area->Shape.area, Child.render->Base.render, Child.area->Shape.area). Corpus absence is separate and measured in script/m14/tmp/svfix-full.mts: 1,893 <script> blocks in shadcn-svelte, 0 class declarations.
